notes.title: Update 1.1 is here / 30% off this week
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Rolling Sun Update 1.1 is there.
Adding new challenge in which you will discover the beauty of a mountain waterfall during a perilous ascent.
And a new branch in the main menu and correction / optimization of many game mechanics.

Many of you were to ask for an additional level. It's done! take a look at "Ascension"

[img]http://nsa37.casimages.com/img/2015/08/10/150810083030703324.jpg[/img][img]http://nsa38.casimages.com/img/2015/08/10/150810083029727595.jpg[/img]

Rolling Sun will be discounted to -30% during the week of 11/9 to 11/15!
If you love physical games and skill, it's time to play Rolling Sun!

Update 1.1 details:

-Added Level "Ultime Ascension".
-Added A new branch to the main menu.
-Added Several notifications and tips.
-Added Light effects.
-Added Fog.

-Improved Physics on the ball.
-Improved controlls with the joystick.
-Improved Physics gameplay elements.

-Fixed Texture bug "Replace me".
-Fixed Runway edges.
-Fixed Some proxy.

notes.title: Demo version available on Steam
notes.notes:
A demo version of Rolling Sun is available on Steam.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/392340?beta=0

The promised update is more longer than expected to achieve. So I decided to offer a demo before the update.
The demo contains two levels from the original game. 

-The first level of adventure.
This will allow you to experience the beginning of the story.

-And a second level that is a level "bonus" that will allow you to experience all the powers of the ball in a more challenging level.

Thank you for your support! 
Stay in touch!

notes.title: Rolling Sun will be updated
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
Rolling Sun is on sale since a week. So I take this opportunity to make a first report.
To be entirely honest with you. There are two things to say.
The first observation is that the game is a bit too short.
The second observation is that it does not sell very well.

I took some decisions in relation to all that.
The first is that I'll do an update that will add a few more levels and some corrections if necessary.
In this way I intend to add some playing time.

I will also give a demo version of the game on Steam. I do not know yet if the free demo will be released simultaneously with the update or not.

I should mention that I am only one working on this game. This means that I'm going to need a little time to do what I promised.
The game is not an "Early access", I have no plans to make regular updates. But I want to do what is necessary for you enjoy the game.

As I say, Rolling Sun is not an "early access". But if you buy the game now, you help me to improve it. To make it a good finalized game.

Thank you for your support! 

Merhunes, Mystik'art.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Rolling Sun
notes.notes:
Rolling Sun is Now Available on Steam!

Rolling Sun has a gameplay based on CRYENGINE's physics with a horizontal scrolling camera in 3D environments. In this game you must lead your ball from left to right but also in depth depending on the obstacles and tracks.
